title: Hold a licence or registration to transport waste
what: Hold the environment regulator's licence, registration or permit before transporting controlled or regulated waste.

laws.title: Waste Management and Resource Recovery Act 2016

sources.title: Waste transporter registration
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this registration if you intend to transport or collect waste.
